name: Tempered Tipbend
description: Chop at the point the eye has marked on the foe and let qi deepen the edge there.

name: Chopbelly Spine
description: Settle into the guard that the eye shows will meet the next cut.

name: Unseen Dragcut
description: Step along the line the gaze has fixed so that the foe never leaves the sight of the blade.

name: Gust Knucklebar
description: Draw a slice exactly along the seam of the foe's armor that the eye has found.

name: Granite Spineback
description: Hew into the instant gap the eye has spotted between two of the foe's motions.

name: Brushnerve
description: Beat the foe's blade at the place it gathers qi and break the gathering.

name: Facet Dishguard
description: Lunge with the tip along the sighted line and pierce a guard at its thinnest place.

name: Chophavoc
description: Cleave into the foe's weakest point as read by the eye with qi packed to pass its defense.

name: Doctrine Swathe
description: Chain a read parry and a gap hew and a weak point cut on the foe's next move.

name: Overpowering Scrape
description: Cut a marked point on the foe's body to seal the flow of qi along that line for a time.

name: Tempered Flatside
description: Open the exchange with a chop that leaves the second court of the blade ready to answer.

name: Facet Bellyblade
description: Hold a pair of guards one high and one low so each court covers the other.

name: Meteoric Brush
description: Exchange places with the foe in two paced steps while keeping the blade between you.

name: Merciless Slice
description: Draw a slice from the first court that finishes in the second court's line.

name: Unbudging Ringpommel
description: Turn the wrist so the first court takes the blow and the second readies the return.

name: Swathehavoc
description: Answer an attack with a hew from the opposite court carrying a fresh pulse of qi.

name: Intent Whisk
description: Lean on the foe from both courts until its blade is pinned between two lines of qi.

name: Harnessing Knucklebar
description: Cross the two courts over the foe's blade and bind it where they meet.

name: Toxin Rearedge
description: Beat from one court and then the other upon the foe's guard and shake its qi loose.

name: Sanguine Ringpommel
description: Cleave from the first court and pass straight on into a second cleave from the other.

name: Intent Dragcut
description: Chain a guard and a parry and an answering cut as one passage between the two courts.

name: Facet Rearedge
description: Receive a strong cut on the first court and return its force along the second onto the attacker.

name: Blazewhisk
description: Chop low and slow as water settles to the floor of a basin and let qi sink into the edge.

name: Unassailable Spineback
description: Settle the guard like silt that thickens against a blow and does not give way.

name: Might Curvespine
description: Move with an unhurried steady step that carries the body round a foe as a slow current would.

name: Blaze Dishguard
description: Hew with a hidden pull beneath the cut like an undertow that drags the foe's guard down.

name: Strangling Slice
description: Hook the foe's blade into a turning current of qi and draw it from its line.

name: Intent Bellyblade
description: Press the foe with the weight of still deep water until it cannot lift its blade.

name: Shattering Curvespine
description: Sweep a rising arc of qi-edged force that lifts and cuts all foes in its reach.

name: Ironchop
description: Cleave with the sudden spill of a brimming basin as stored qi pours down the edge.

name: Rumbleswathe
description: Surge from the basin's depth across the gap in an instant and cut as the foe registers it.

name: Swathescourge
description: Chop along the first azure track with the second track held open behind it.

name: Hoarfrost Tipbend
description: Weave the blade through two linked guards so that no line is left open.

name: Unseen Brush
description: Glide along two tracks of footwork that cross and part again beneath the body.

name: Blazechop
description: Draw a slice that runs along one track and returns along the other.

name: Equipoise Curvespine
description: Switch tracks at the wrist as the blades meet and throw the foe's cut wide.

name: Pitiless Scrape
description: Hew along both tracks in one swing so the stroke lands on two points together.

name: Mastering Bellyblade
description: Catch the foe's blade between two tracks of the edge and lock it there.

name: Immobilizing Flatside
description: Switch tracks in the middle of a beat to jar the foe's qi from its pattern.

name: Might Chopbelly
description: Cleave on the first track and then the second with qi passing from one to the other.

name: Chopwrath
description: Weave guard and cut and parry along both tracks as one qi-led sequence.

name: Hollowbevel
description: Meet an advanced technique with both tracks of the blade and cancel the pattern of its qi in the clash.

name: Tempered Chopbelly
description: Dive in on the foe with a chop and leave the blade poised for a second dive.

name: Indomitable Rearedge
description: Fold the blade and arm into a double guard like two hawks with wings drawn in.

name: Might Scrape
description: Glide in a long low approach and follow with a second glide that changes the angle.

name: Granite Slice
description: Draw a raking slice at the end of the dive and pull back to the second.

name: Equipoise Knucklebar
description: Beat aside a cut with the first wing and ready the second wing for the return.

name: Blaze Dragcut
description: Hew from above in a stoop and follow at once with a second hew from the rebound.

name: Dishspine
description: Rake and hook the foe's wrist with two successive pulls that pin its arm.

name: Hour Spineback
description: Hover over the foe in a threatening circle and keep it still by the dive that may follow.

name: Swathe Valor
description: Beat the foe's blade twice like two talons striking and scatter its qi.

name: Ferocious Brush
description: Gather qi at a height and descend in a cleave and then a second cleave from the same fall.

name: Lacerating Tipbend
description: Sweep the blade about in a double arc that cuts every foe near the dive.

name: Doctrine Whisk
description: Chain the dive and the rebound and the second dive and return to guard as one sequence.

name: Merciless Dishguard
description: Descend twice on one point of the foe's guard with qi that tears through its defense.

name: Corroding Flatside
description: Chop low like a river carving its bed with the weight of the whole body behind the edge.

name: Iron Dishguard
description: Hold a guard that bends like reeds on a bank and springs back after a blow.

name: Silt Ringpommel
description: Advance through the foe's attack with the careful footing of one wading a stream.

name: Gust Ringpommel
description: Draw a slice in a lazy meander that arrives from an unexpected angle.

name: Grievous Bellyblade
description: Hew with a steady running flow of qi that does not break between guard and cut.

name: Fastening Whisk
description: Spin the blade in a small eddy that catches the foe's weapon and turns it aside.

name: Dishvalor
description: Beat in the rapid churning manner of white water and break the foe's rhythm of qi.

name: Blazeslice
description: Gather a flood of qi and cleave with the full torrent behind the stroke.

name: Curvespine Nerve
description: Hold a blow like a weir holds water and let it spill back as a counter cut.

name: Strangling Scrape
description: Cut with a flood of qi that overwhelms the channels of the foe and stops its circulation for a time.

name: Lacerating Rearedge
description: Chop and turn the blade at once so the return stroke comes on the same line reversed.

name: Chopbelly Nerve
description: Guard on one side and turn to the other in an instant so the blow finds only steel.

name: Silt Whisk
description: Step forward and back in a matched pair that leaves the foe misjudging the distance.

name: Tempered Swathe
description: Draw a slice forward and then turn the blade to draw it back along the same cut.

name: Murk Knucklebar
description: Parry and reverse the turn of the wrist to send the foe's blade back on its path.

name: Brushhavoc
description: Hew down and reverse up in a single breath so the foe's guard is caught going the wrong way.

name: Gyvebrush
description: Turn the blade over the foe's weapon and pull it down and across in a locking reversal.

name: Hourswathe
description: Press the foe with alternating cuts and turns that sap its qi each time it answers.

name: Toxin Flatside
description: Beat the foe's blade and the same place again from the other side to jar its technique.

name: Spineback Wrath
description: Cleave through the foe's guard and turn at once to cleave back through the same opening.

name: Intentbrush
description: Chain turn and counter and turn again as one sequence that leaves the foe facing the wrong way.

name: Meteoric Nova Brush
description: Flash across the gap and back in the span of a breath and cut as the foe turns.

name: Thorn Tipbend
description: Settle into a deep still guard like water in a basin that takes any weight.

name: Swatheflash
description: Move only as the foe moves and keep the same distance and the same still guard.

name: Slicescourge
description: Chop with the spine of the sabre as a heavy hammer from the settled guard.

name: Slice Reckoning
description: Hew with the pressure of deep water behind the edge and no wasted motion.

name: Evergreen Knucklebar
description: Hold an attack in the basin of the blade and let its qi drain away unspent.

name: Unsparing Dishguard
description: Press down on the foe's blade with the whole stored weight of the basin.

name: Rumblescrape
description: Cleave at the instant the basin brims and its stored qi spills through the edge.

name: Unrelenting Bellyblade
description: Take a blow into the deep guard and return it as a short counter cut.

name: Ironclad Spineback
description: Hold the deep guard so that a technique poured into it loses its pattern and falls apart.

name: Hellish Flatside
description: Chop along the bearing sworn to the foe's heart and let qi gather in the edge.

name: Hoarfrost Ringpommel
description: Hold the guard on the sworn bearing so every attack meets the blade first.

name: Dishblink
description: Pace along the sworn bearing in measured steps with the point trained on the foe.

name: Pitiless Tipbend
description: Draw a slice along the bearing in a long even stroke with qi on the belly.

name: Murk Chopbelly
description: Turn the wrist to hold the bearing while the foe's cut is thrown to the side.

name: Brushwrath
description: Hew along the held bearing with qi renewed at the instant the oath is voiced.

name: Webbing Swathe
description: Bind the foe's blade to the sworn bearing so it cannot cross the line.

name: Rumble Curvespine
description: Beat the foe's blade hard on the bearing and break the gathering of its qi.

name: Sliceruin
description: Gather qi on the held bearing and cleave along it with the whole weight of the oath.

name: Hour Scrape
description: Chain a pace and a bind and a cleave along one sworn bearing as a single sequence.

name: Mastering Fastening Slice
description: Cut along the sworn bearing to close the channels of the foe's qi and hold them shut a time.

name: Titanic Brush
description: Chop with the sudden force of a gale across a plateau and the hips driving through.

name: Bevelmettle
description: Hold the blade crosswise like a break in the wind so cuts are shed to either side.

name: Rearedge Rocketry
description: Cross open ground in a few long steps with the gale at the back.

name: Eviscerating Whisk
description: Hew from a wide stance with qi streaming down the blade like wind over flat ground.

name: Fastening Brush
description: Hook the foe's blade in a gust of motion and drag it out of its line.

name: Toxin Swathe
description: Rap the foe's blade in quick blows that unsettle its qi like buffeting wind.

name: Downpour Slice
description: Sweep the sabre round in a wide gale arc that cuts every foe along the rim of its reach.

name: Rumble Dishguard
description: Gather the gale in the arms and bring it down as a single cleave.

name: Ghosting Swathe
description: Cross open ground in a flash of gale and cut the foe before the wind of it arrives.

name: Brutalizing Spineback
description: Chop on the sworn line and no further so that the cut ends where the oath ends.

name: Irondish
description: Hold the blade along the line before the body and let nothing cross it.

name: Might Knucklebar
description: Step along the sworn line with the feet never straying beyond it.

name: Granite Flatside
description: Draw a slice along the line from one end of the foe's reach to the other.

name: Equipoise Tipbend
description: Turn the wrist and hold the line while an attack is carried out beyond it.

name: Scrapescourge
description: Hew straight down the sworn line with qi renewed at the instant of the oath.

name: Fastening Scrape
description: Hook the foe's blade where it crosses the line and hold it there.

name: Ponderous Ringpommel
description: Advance the sworn line steadily and press the foe back across its own ground.

name: Hogtying Whisk
description: Beat any blade that strikes across the line and scatter the qi that drives it.

name: Rearedge Havoc
description: Cleave along the line with qi gathered from the whole field in one clean stroke.

name: Curvespine Scourge
description: Chain guard and snare and cleave on one sworn line as a single qi-led sequence.

name: Unbowed Bellyblade Spine
description: Draw the sworn line before the body so that a technique crossing it is cancelled in its pattern.

name: Iron Bellyblade
description: Chop at the bearing taken on the foe from the very edge of a drop.

name: Invincible Ringpommel
description: Hold a firm guard with the heels at the brink where there is no room to retreat.

name: Blinding Knucklebar
description: Step to take a fresh bearing on the foe without leaving the edge of the ground.

name: Bevelscourge
description: Draw a slice that falls away at its end like the drop of a cliff.

name: Ruinous Brush
description: Hew downward with the full drop of the body and qi flowing with the fall.

name: Bevelvalor
description: Hook the foe's blade onto the bearing and hold it fast on the line.

name: Mayhem Tipbend
description: Beat from the brink of the bearing and jar the foe's qi out of its form.

name: Brushruin
description: Gather qi at the brink and cleave with the weight of a fall from the cliff.

name: Equipoise Dishguard
description: Turn an attack aside on the bearing and return a cut along the same line.

name: Intent Chopbelly
description: Cut at the brink to close the foe's meridians so its qi cannot pass for a time.

name: Rumble Spineback
description: Chop from bare open ground with a wide stance that grips the earth.

name: Facetdish
description: Hold a loose guard that lets blows fall past like dust shed from the blade.

name: Dragcut Glimmer
description: Run in a few long strides across flat ground with the blade carried low.

name: Mightdish
description: Draw a wide slice under the open sky that follows the foe's every shift.

name: Torrent Rearedge
description: Parry across the wind and let the foe's cut be carried off like a thrown leaf.

name: Wrathful Dragcut
description: Hew with a long open stride and the push of the steppe wind behind it.

name: Hoarfrost Scrape
description: Hook the foe's blade and pull it wide as a gale pulls a loose cloak.

name: Brushscourge
description: Press the foe with rolling gusts of cuts that leave it no ground to settle.

name: Mayhem Swathe
description: Beat the foe's blade in a burst of qi that scatters like a cloud of dust.

name: Flatside Ruin
description: Gather the wind of the steppe in the blade and cleave with its whole force.

name: Daybreak Curvespine
description: Spin the sabre in a whirling ring and cut every foe who stands within the reach of the gale.

name: Lotswathe
description: Chain a run and a pull and a cleave as one gale front sweeping through the foe.

name: Crushing Whisk
description: Drive the whole gale through a single point of the foe's guard to rend through its defense.

name: Eviscerating Curvespine
description: Chop from a skyward raised blade after an oath spoken to the open sky.

name: Charter Chopbelly
description: Hold a quiet watchful guard through the night as if keeping a vigil.

name: Flatside Slipstream
description: Pace slowly about the foe as in a night watch with the blade ever ready.

name: Booming Spineback
description: Draw a long slice beneath the open sky that holds the oath to the last of the stroke.

name: Murk Tipbend
description: Turn the wrist the instant the foe moves and send its cut away from the body.

name: Scrapehavoc
description: Hew at the moment the foe commits and add qi to the edge to deepen the cut.

name: Numbing Rearedge
description: Hook and hold the foe's blade as a watcher holds a sworn post.

name: Unsparing Dragcut
description: Hold the foe still beneath the steady threat of a patient blade and an unbroken vigil.

name: Slicehavoc
description: Raise the blade skyward and gather qi through the oath then cleave in one long fall.

name: Hourbevel
description: Chain a patient parry and a snare and a cleave as one qi-led sequence of the vigil.

name: Indomitable Ringpommel
description: Take a heavy blow on the oath-held blade and return its force to the attacker in a cut.

name: Sanguine Bellyblade
description: Chop along the rim of the plateau and turn on the heel into the return.

name: Dishdurance
description: Guard on the rim and reverse the hold of the blade as the blow arrives.

name: Brushflash
description: Pivot along the rim line and come about to face the foe from the opposite side.

name: Blaze Chopbelly
description: Draw a slice out along the rim and turn the blade to draw it back.

name: Torrent Dishguard
description: Parry with the wind and then turn against it so the foe's cut is sent back.

name: Rampaging Slice
description: Hew in one direction and reverse at once so the foe's guard is caught going the wrong way.

name: Thornwhisk
description: Hook the foe's blade round and back and hold it in the reversal.

name: Hourbrush
description: Drive the foe along the rim with alternating cuts that give it no turn to make.

name: Hogtying Knucklebar
description: Beat the foe's blade and reverse the stroke to jar its qi from its pattern.

name: Sanguine Dragcut
description: Cleave through the foe's guard and turn to cleave back along the same opening.

name: Lotchop
description: Chain turn and counter and turn again along the rim as one qi-led sequence.

name: Ghosting Brush Slipstream
description: Flash along the rim and back in the space of a breath and cut as the foe turns.

name: Scrapewrath
description: Chop alone and unaided along a bearing held without any support.

name: Facet Knucklebar
description: Hold the guard alone with no companion at the back and no ground to give.

name: Gust Dragcut
description: Step along the held bearing alone and keep the same fixed distance from the foe.

name: Iron Tipbend
description: Hew along the lone bearing with qi gathered from a steady breath.

name: Murk Curvespine
description: Parry the foe's cut and unsettle its qi with the stillness of one standing alone.

name: Shade Scrape
description: Hold the line alone and press the foe back by the weight of an unbroken stance.

name: Slice Devastation
description: Cleave along the lone bearing with every part of the body and the whole field of qi.

name: Rearedge Mettle
description: Turn a blow aside on the lone bearing and return a short cut at the foe's wrist.

name: Beveldurance
description: Hold the lone bearing so that any technique crossing it loses its pattern and fails.
